frozen_candidate_root_contribution: Relational NON-IDENTITY: gyr marks a referent as other-than / distinct-from a specified standard X. It is inherently two-place and functional, carrying no positive descriptive content of its own — it only brackets what falls outside the identity of X. In the derived stems this same 'otherness' is verbalized: Form II (causative) = make-other = alter; Form V (mediopassive) = become-other = change.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: Relational NON-IDENTITY: gyr marks a referent as other-than / distinct-from a specified standard X. It is inherently two-place and functional, carrying no positive descriptive content of its own — it only brackets what falls outside the identity of X. In the derived stems this same 'otherness' is verbalized: Form II (causative) = make-other = alter; Form V (mediopassive) = become-other = change.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: In ~95% of its occurrences gyr is the single case-inflected word ghayr, a relational operator meaning 'other than / not-the-same-as' a named foil: 'no god other than Him', 'people other than you', 'a reward not-cut-off', 'without knowledge/right/reckoning'. It brackets good, bad and neutral alike, so it has no built-in evaluation, and it names a static difference, not a process. The six derived-stem verbs (Forms II and V) add the event: to make something other (alter) or to become other (change) — e.g. 'God does not change what is in a people until they change what is in themselves', 'milk whose taste does not become-other'. The Quran itself glosses change as producing ghayr ('the earth is changed into other-than-the-earth', 14:48; 'skins other than theirs', 4:56), which bridges the noun and the verbs. One occurrence, 100:3 al-mughirat ('the raiders/chargers at dawn', a Form-IV hapax in a martial oath series), has no Quran-internal path to otherness and is left resistant.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: gyr does NOT mean (1) 'change/alteration' at the bare-noun level — the process sense appears only under Form II/V morphology, while all 147 nominal tokens are static; (2) 'hidden/absent/unseen' — nothing supports concealment; (3) an evaluative 'inferior/worse other' — it is polarity-neutral, heading praise (ajr ghayr mamnun) and blame (qawlan ghayra alladhi qila) identically; (4) 'opposite/contrary' — it marks mere non-identity (buyutan ghayra buyutikum = other houses, not anti-houses), weaker than antonymy; (5) sentential negation — it negates identity/attribution in a nominal slot (amwat ghayr ahya), not a clause; (6) additive plurality 'one more of the same' — fixed by the internal minimal pair 5:106 (akharan 'further witnesses' vs min ghayrikum 'from other-than you'); (7) the act of substitution itself (that is baddala/bdl) — ghayr only names the resulting other-ness; (8) 'raid/attack' — the sense of 100:3 is unreachable from the nucleus.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 100:3:1:3 fa-al-mughirat subhan ('the chargers/raiders at dawn'), a Form-IV hapax and the sole N(IV) in the root, embedded in a martial oath series (al-'adiyat / al-muriyat / al-mughirat) whose members denote violent cavalry motion. On no Quran-internal evidence does 'the raiders at dawn' reduce to otherness, difference, or change; the only route to fold it in ('a raid makes things other') requires the external lexical premise that aghara 'to raid' shares the gyr nucleus, which the source policy forbids. It is therefore an unbridged, lexicalized/homonymous nominal that no single account covers, and it caps the whole-root claim below STRONG/UNIVERSAL.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: The strongest rival is that the root core is CHANGE/ALTERATION (taghyir) and ghayr ('the different one') is a derived nominal, attractive because the morphologically verbal members (II/V) unambiguously mean change. It is rejected on narrowness and directionality: it overloads 147 demonstrably static, relational uses ('no god other than Him' involves no alteration) with a change nuance they lack, and it derives the general (relational otherness) from the special (dynamic change) — the wrong direction. The non-identity account is strictly narrower and simultaneously more general: it explains the particle directly and yields the verbs for free via standard Form-II causative and Form-V mediopassive semantics. A second rival, nucleus = 'negation', fails on the substitutive A1 uses (qawman ghayrakum, buyutan ghayra buyutikum) which are difference without negation. A third rival, three-way homonymy (other-than / change / raid), is accepted only for 100:3 and rejected for the noun-vs-verb split, since 'make-other' is the transparent derivational value of the D-stem of 'other', bridged in-text by 10:15 (ghayr || baddil) and 47:15 (taghayyara = 'become-other').

internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses converge. Regrouping by behavior (QAC N-vs-ADJ is agreement-driven, not semantic: the identical collocation ajr ghayr mamnun is tagged ADJ at 84:25 but N at 41:8/68:3/95:6), the 154 occurrences form: (A) the ghayr non-identity operator, N 144 + ADJ 3 = 147, internally coherent across substitutive 'other-than', privative bi-ghayri 'without', and negated-attribute 'not-/un-' uses; (B) the derived make/become-other change family, V(II) 4 + N(II) 1 + V(V) 1 = 6, joined to (A) by regular derivational morphology plus the in-text bdl<->ghayr hinge (14:48, 4:56, 2:59) and the 47:15 parallel; (C) the outlier al-mughirat, N(IV) 1 = 100:3, resistant. For 153/154 the non-identity account is broad, distinctive, and adversarially clean (in isolation it would merit STRONG), and the internal minimal pair 5:106 secures distinctiveness from akhar. But per contract a resistant lexicalized/nominal sub-class caps strength at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE, and 100:3 is exactly such an unbridged member; additionally the noun<->verb bridge is inferential (theme + morphology), never a single-predication identity, which independently blocks UNIVERSAL. Hence MODERATE / REPRESENTATIVE, DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: ghayr as a two-place non-identity operator: it sets a referent apart from a named foil X ('X-that-is-not-Y'). Realized as (a) excluded alternative / other-than (ilahin ghayruhu, qawman ghayrakum, ghayra al-islami dinan), (b) privative bi-ghayri / min ghayri 'without' (bi-ghayri 'ilm / haqq / hisab / 'amad), (c) negated attribute 'not-/un-' (ajr ghayr mamnun, amwat ghayr ahya', ghayra baghin), all reducible to non-identity relative to a reference.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Derived-stem verbalization of 'otherness': Form II (causative, transitive) = render X other-than-its-prior-state = alter (yughayyiru ma bi-qawmin, fa-layughayyirunna khalq allah, mughayyiran ni'matan); Form V (mediopassive) = come-to-be-other = change intransitively (lam yatagayyar ta'muhu). clusters.classification_rationale: Morphologically bridged to Cluster A by standard II-causative / V-reflexive semantics, and Quran-internally bridged by the bdl<->ghayr hinge (14:48, 4:56, 2:59) and the 47:15 parallel (ma' ghayr asin 'water not-stale' alongside laban lam yatagayyar 'milk not become-other'). The bridge is inferential (theme + morphology), not a single-predication identity.

The bridge is inferential (theme + morphology), not a single-predication identity.

resistant_deep_analysis.preliminary_note: Attempted to absorb al-mughirat into the non-identity nucleus via 'a raid makes things other-than-before'.
resistant_deep_analysis.reconciliation_rationale: The proposed extension is only reachable through an inherited lexical prior (aghara = raid), not through any Quran-internal occurrence; all 153 other tokens carry no nuance of onrush/attack. Per contract this is a resistant lexicalized nominal sub-class, so it is left RESISTANT and caps the root grade at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.

independent_verification: Three independent lenses (A, B, and adversary C) converged on the same nucleus, the same 153/154 coverage, and the same single resistant occurrence 100:3.
candidate_root_contribution: Relational NON-IDENTITY: gyr marks a referent as other-than / distinct-from a specified standard X. It is inherently two-place and functional, carrying no positive descriptive content of its own — it only brackets what falls outside the identity of X. In the derived stems this same 'otherness' is verbalized: Form II (causative) = make-other = alter; Form V (mediopassive) = become-other = change.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 154 occurrences, full coverage; 147 static relational ghayr tokens (nom/acc/gen inflections of one lexeme), 6 derived Form II/V change verbs, 1 Form IV hapax al-mughirat.
layer_attribution.derivation: Form II (causative) = 'make other' = alter (13:11, 4:119, 8:53); Form V (mediopassive) = 'become other' = change (47:15); N(II) participle mughayyir (8:53). Change is stem-supplied, not part of the bare-root minimum.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: ghayr is a functional/relational quasi-particle (non-identity operator), not a self-standing content noun; it always governs or negates a complement. QAC N-vs-ADJ is agreement-driven and semantically inert.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Contextual readings (deity exclusion 'no god other than Him', 'without knowledge/right', 'a reward not-cut-off', 'raiders at dawn') are verse-level narrative meanings and must NOT be promoted to the root claim; the root contributes only the abstract non-identity relation.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: Preliminary attempt to absorb 100:3 into the nucleus was overturned by the verifier objection that the bridge needs a forbidden external lexical prior; final disposition RESISTANT, capping the grade at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: 100:3:1:3 al-mughirat remains an unbridged lexicalized/homonymous nominal outside the non-identity nucleus; it is the sole persisted resistance and blocks UNIVERSAL/STRONG.

hard_cases.reason: Form-IV hapax al-mughirat ('raiders at dawn') in a martial oath series with no Quran-internal bridge to the non-identity nucleus; absorbing it needs the forbidden external prior that aghara 'to raid' shares the gyr root.

evidence_basis.statement: On no Quran-internal evidence does 'the raiders at dawn' reduce to otherness, difference, or change; the only route to fold it in ('a raid makes things other') requires the external lexical premise that aghara 'to raid' shares the gyr nucleus, which the source policy forbids

hard_case_representation.rationale: There is exactly one genuine resistant occurrence (100:3:1:3). It is represented as a RESISTANT_SEAM hard case with an occurrence-isolation evidence basis whose statement also appears verbatim within strongest_counterexample; it is listed in counterevidence_refs and in cluster C's counterevidence.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A bare-noun ghayr occurrence (Form N or ADJ, qac_verb_form null) that carries intrinsic 'change/process' content or intrinsic evaluative polarity independent of any Form II/V morphology or its governed complement, OR a Quran-internal occurrence that demonstrably bridges 100:3 al-mughirat to the otherness/change nucleus without an external lexical prior.
rejection_condition.search_location: The 147 nominal ghayr tokens (esp. the static privatives bi-ghayri 'ilm/haqq/hisab and the deity-exclusion frames) and the 100:3 oath context (100:1-5), cross-checked against the 6 Form II/V verbs.
rejection_condition.verification_method: For each candidate, strip the governed complement and the stem morphology and test whether a residual 'change' or 'evaluation' meaning remains attributable to the root; for 100:3, seek any second gyr occurrence sharing an onrush/attack nuance to establish an internal distributional bridge.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Separate root contribution from (a) the complement's own semantics (deity, haqq, 'ilm), (b) change carried by co-text baddala/bdl rather than by ghayr, and (c) stem-supplied causative/mediopassive meaning in Forms II/V; reject inherited dictionary/lexicon glosses of aghara.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If such a static-noun change/polarity sense is found, the narrow non-identity nucleus is falsified and the account must move toward a change-core or split; if an internal bridge for 100:3 is found, the resistant seam dissolves and the grade could rise to STRONG/UNIVERSAL.

reopen_conditions: If any additional occurrence of the gyr consonantal skeleton in an onrush/raid/attack sense is identified Quran-internally, re-examine whether 100:3 al-mughirat forms its own coherent class or bridges to the nucleus.

If a Form II/V verb (e.g. re-analysis of 13:11 yughayyiru or 47:15 yatagayyar) is shown to mean something other than 'make/become other-than-prior', re-test the derivational bridge between Cluster A (ghayr) and Cluster B.

If a static nominal ghayr token (e.g. among the bi-ghayri privatives 22:40 / 6:100 or the deity-exclusion frames 11:50 / 28:71) is shown to carry intrinsic change or evaluative polarity, reopen the narrow non-identity nucleus.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The non-identity account survives adversarial pressure across 153/154 occurrences (distinctiveness fixed by 5:106 vs akhar; noun<->verb bridge by 14:48/47:15), but one occurrence (100:3) genuinely resists, so a clean SUPPORTED/PASSED with empty failing_occurrences cannot be claimed. Per contract this is recorded as NOT_RUN with the resistant occurrence noted rather than PASSED or FAILED.
